name: html-inline-button-in-paragraph-runtime-handler-fallback
description: Negative guard for inline-button-in-paragraph promotion: a button wired to runtime behavior (aria-controls/aria-expanded, a disclosure toggle) still forces the paragraph to core/html. Only a static, behavior-free button is safe to flatten into RichText.

source_reference.notes: Shares its unsafe-attribute list with ButtonsPattern::hasRuntimeBehaviorSignal() and ElementConversionPrelude::requiresWrappedButtonPreservation().

legacy_comparison.reason: Negative guard for new inline-button-in-paragraph promotion.
